title: Three Terms and One Short Tube
subtitle: 成功成就 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）
meta: 主题语境：成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）　|　核心词汇：outcome　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 outcome 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 the researcher ① judged the outcome that no student in the lab would have described, and he said the judging was the whole of the term. The ② outcome, meaning the result itself and not the tube, ran three terms and stayed undescribed in the book; an outcome, he said, is the only thing in a lab that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ outcome in that lab had the same short tube beside it, and the ④ outcome at the far bench, meaning the sample they kept for the children to test and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An outcome, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the researcher said the describing is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the outcome was the whole of the matter, meaning the meaning and not the result. The ⑥ outcome, meaning the meaning and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; outcome, he said, is either something you judge or the only word that means both a result and a meaning. He said the meaning is the part they remember.

By 1963 the ⑦ outcome had become a line in a paper, and the paper had become an argument about the short tube. The ⑧ outcome of the whole thing, the researcher wrote in February, was one lab and three terms of describing; outcome, he said, is either the sample at the far bench or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ outcome I remember is the result described in the paper, which closed in 1965 and is still described as the quietest in the lab. An ⑩ outcome, my mother said in 1967, is the only result that improves by being described; every outcome, she said, is a meaning that has agreed to look like a result. She said the meaning was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 结果；成果（指实验室里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 结果；成果（指那个结果本身，与细细的试管相对）
C. 固定搭配：judge the outcome 判定这一个结果
D. n. 结果；成果（指留给孩子们测的那一份）
E. n. 结果之事（抽象总称，指一处实验室的结果之事）
F. n. 结果；成果（指研究报告里写到、被描述的那一个）
G. n. 结果、分晓（指一件事里人人都测却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 分晓（抽象总称，指人人都测却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: judged the outcome that no student in the lab would have described
The outcome, meaning the result itself and not the tube
the outcome at the far bench
the outcome was the whole of the matter
the outcome had become a line in a paper
The outcome of the whole thing
An outcome, my mother said in 1967

answers.why: judge the outcome 意为“判定这一个结果”，1958 年那位研究员把实验室里没有一位学生肯描述的一个结果做了一遍。
outcome 意为“结果；成果”，指那个结果本身而不是细细的试管，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被描述。
outcome 意为“结果；成果”，指实验室里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一支细细的试管。
outcome 意为“结果；成果”，指最远那张实验台的留给孩子们测的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
outcome 意为“结果、分晓”，指一件事里人人都测却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个分晓就是那件事的全部。
outcome 意为“分晓”，指人人都测却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个结果，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
outcome 意为“结果；成果”，指研究报告里写到、被描述的那一个，到 1963 年这一个成了研究报告里的一行。
outcome 意为“结果之事”，研究员二月写道，整件事的结果之事是一处实验室和三个学期的描述。
outcome 意为“结果；成果”，我记得的是研究报告里描述过的那一个，1965 年测定了，至今仍被说成实验室里最安静的一个。
outcome 为抽象总称，母亲 1967 年说，结果是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的结果。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1958 年那位研究员判定了实验室里没有一位学生肯描述的一个结果，他说这一遍才是那个学期的全部。（judge the outcome）
那个结果，指的是那个结果本身而不是细细的试管，经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被描述。（outcome）
那处实验室里每一个结果旁边都有同一支细细的试管。（outcome）
最远那张实验台那个结果，指的是他们留给孩子们测的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（outcome）
叔叔说这个分晓就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那个结果。（outcome）
1967 年母亲说，结果是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的结果。（outcome）
